verdict.rationale: Airwallex Billing documents its own subscription management, including multi-item and multi-frequency recurring billing and recurring invoices, built on top of payments acceptance. That covers recurring subscriptions with plan-like structures. Nothing in the evidence addresses trials, mid-cycle upgrades/downgrades, or proration. Missing for 10: documented free trials, plan upgrade/downgrade flows, proration logic, API-level subscription endpoint detail, independent/hands-on corroboration.
